label: noaa-swdi
disclaimer: Radar-estimated hail size. Possible hail damage only — not a confirmed inspection. NOAA data is used without implying NOAA endorsement. This file is a derived summary, not an original NOAA product. NEXRAD signature times are UTC and can fall on the previous evening in Central time.

sources.title: NOAA NCEI Severe Weather Data Inventory, NEXRAD Level-III hail signatures

mesh.note: Address lookup uses NCEI hail-signature locations so a static page can match within about 10 km. MRMS MESH_Max_1440min GRIB2 is on s3://noaa-mrms-pds with no AWS account. This build does not parse those grids unless you pass --with-mesh on a machine with ecCodes grib_ls.
